shortDescription: Argentina's 2026/27 wheat production forecast, currently of 23.4 million metric tons, could be raised due to higher-than-expected yields as the harvest progresses, the Buenos Aires grains exchange said on Thursday.

children: Argentina's 2026/27 wheat production forecast, currently of 23.4 million metric tons, could be raised due to higher-than-expected yields as the harvest progresses, the Buenos Aires grains exchange said on Thursday.
The current harvest forecast is the country's second-highest on record
Argentina is a key global wheat exporter, and the crop has benefited this season from favorable rainfall and low temperatures
The exchange estimates average wheat yield at between 1.7 and 2.4 tons per hectare
It estimates 24.9% of the sown area has been harvested, and expects it to keep rising
"If these yields are sustained, an upward revision of the production forecast cannot be ruled out," the exchange said
Soybean planting for the 2026/27 cycle is 39.7% complete, while corn planting has reached 52.7%, according to the exchange
The exchange estimates the 2026/27 total soybean production at 53.6 million tons and projects the corn harvest to be of 66 million tons
